devdoc.details: Simplified factory contract for deploying ERC1967 proxies with deterministic addresses This factory allows anyone to deploy proxies for any implementation contract using CREATE2 for deterministic addresses

deployProxy(address,bytes,bytes32).details: Deploys a proxy for any implementation with arbitrary initialization data

params.initData: The initialization data to be passed to the proxy
params.salt: A unique value to ensure deterministic address generation

returns.proxy: The address of the deployed proxy

predictProxyAddress(address,bytes,bytes3.details: Predicts the address where a proxy will be deployed

params.deployer: The address that will deploy the proxy
params.initData: The initialization data to be passed to the proxy
params.salt: A unique value to ensure deterministic address generation
